name: Child Nurse
original_name: 子守《チャイルド・ナース》
source:
One of the pursuers from C.R.O.W.N., a secret society that's chasing after the main characters.

Her main role is that of an assassin, but she doesn’t like blending with the crowds, so she dyes her hair and wears clothes in a unique way. 

She uses box cutters as her weapon of choice and enjoys taking her time with her targets, tormenting them as she slowly kills them.

Hometown: France
